title: robotsix-linkedin configuration
description: Settings for the robotsix-linkedin service. Each property maps to a LINKEDIN_* environment variable (env_prefix "LINKEDIN_") consumed by the pydantic Settings class in src/linkedin_service/config.py. Secret fields are flagged with "secret": true and "writeOnly": true so the deploy plane injects them from a secure store rather than committing them.

linkedin_client_id.title: LinkedIn OAuth client id
linkedin_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id issued for the LinkedIn app (LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID).

linkedin_client_secret.title: LinkedIn OAuth client secret
linkedin_client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret issued for the LinkedIn app (LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET). Never commit a real value.

linkedin_redirect_uri.title: OAuth redirect URI
linkedin_redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI registered on the LinkedIn app; must match exactly (LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI).

linkedin_allowed_redirect_uris.title: Additional allowed redirect URIs
linkedin_allowed_redirect_uris.description: Space- or comma-separated allowlist of extra redirect URIs permitted by the OAuth flow, in addition to linkedin_redirect_uri (LINKEDIN_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_URIS). Empty allows only linkedin_redirect_uri.

linkedin_scopes.title: OAuth scopes
linkedin_scopes.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes requested on the consent screen (LINKEDIN_SCOPES).

linkedin_token_file.title: OAuth token file path
linkedin_token_file.description: Path where OAuth access/refresh tokens are persisted, outside the repo (LINKEDIN_TOKEN_FILE). Set to an empty string to disable on-disk persistence.

port.title: Bind port
port.description: TCP port the service listens on (LINKEDIN_PORT).

require_operator_confirmation.title: Require operator confirmation
require_operator_confirmation.description: When true, write endpoints require an explicit operator confirmation token before calling LinkedIn (LINKEDIN_REQUIRE_OPERATOR_CONFIRMATION).
